tellings.difference: Dated 2006-2009 rather than 2005-2008, and credits the book A State of Mind.
tellings.link_reason: Same DOE headquarters hazing ritual, in which new appointees were told about aliens and Roswell technology, told firsthand by Mowatt-Larssen.

plain: A former CIA officer named Rolf Mowatt-Larssen says that in the mid 2000s, new political appointees at the Department of Energy were put through a hazing ritual in a vault at its Washington headquarters. They were given a mock briefing on a top-secret program saying the US really did have aliens, one injured and one not, and had obtained alien space technology through Roswell, the 1947 crash in New Mexico. Mowatt-Larssen says he saw this himself, and on one telling he dates it 2006 to 2009 and points to his book A State of Mind: Faith and the CIA.
